issue.title: Fix login timeout
issue.body: Users report being logged out after 2 minutes of inactivity.

notes: The connector must verify the X-Hub-Signature-256 header using the secret.
Only process when X-GitHub-Event is 'issues' and action is 'labeled' and the label name is 'bug'.
The payload includes issue.title, issue.body, issue.html_url, repository.full_name, and sender.login.
The X-GitHub-Delivery header can be used as an idempotency key.

example.query: mutation IssueCreate { issueCreate(input: { title: "Fix login timeout", description: "Users report being logged out after 2 minutes of inactivity.", teamId: "9cfb482a-81e3-4154-b5b9-2c805e70a02d" }) { success issue { id title } } }

notes: The teamId must be known or resolvable (e.g., via a prior query to get team ID by name).
If the Triage workflow state is enabled for the team, the issue will be placed there by default.
Authentication can be via personal API key (Authorization: <key>) or OAuth bearer token.
The GraphQL endpoint supports introspection and follows standard GraphQL error format.
